import html # Template for rendering a user post. The placeholders are: # {username} – the author's name # {title} – the post title # {body} – the main content of the post # {tags} – a string containing all tags wrapped in elements USER_POST_FORMAT = ( '
\n' '
\n' '

{title}

\n' '

Posted by: {username}

\n' '
\n' '
{body}
\n' '
{tags}
\n' '
' ) def render_user_post(username: str, post_title: str, post_body: str, tags: list[str]) -> str: """ Render a user-generated post as sanitized HTML. Args: username: The name of the user who created the post. post_title: The title of the post. post_body: The main content of the post. tags: A list of tags added by the user. Returns: A string containing the HTML representation of the post with all user-provided content properly escaped to prevent XSS. Raises: TypeError: If any argument is not of the expected type. """ # Validate input types if not isinstance(username, str): raise TypeError("username must be a string") if not isinstance(post_title, str): raise TypeError("post_title must be a string") if not isinstance(post_body, str): raise TypeError("post_body must be a string") if not isinstance(tags, list) or not all(isinstance(t, str) for t in tags): raise TypeError("tags must be a list of strings") # Escape user input to neutralize HTML/JS injection esc_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) esc_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) esc_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=False) # preserve newlines # Render tags as elements escaped_tags = [] for tag in tags: esc_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) escaped_tags.append(f'{esc_tag}') tags_html = ' '.join(escaped_tags) # Format the final HTML return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username=esc_username, title=esc_title, body=esc_body.replace('\n', '
'), tags=tags_html )
